build_image_processor: build an EfficientLoFTRImageProcessorPil instance with custom grayscale and resize settings for keypoint matching
preprocess_image_pairs: preprocess image pairs by resizing, rescaling, and converting to grayscale for EfficientLoFTR model input
post_process_keypoint_matching: post-process EfficientLoFTR keypoint matching output by scaling keypoints back to original image sizes and filtering by score threshold
visualize_keypoint_matching: visualize keypoint matching results by plotting image pairs side by side with colored matching lines and keypoint markers
convert_to_grayscale: convert a PIL or numpy image to grayscale using the NTSC luminance formula
